name: Human
description: Versatile and adaptable, humans are the most common race, gaining a small bonus to all attributes.

name: Elf
description: Graceful and long-lived, elves have keen senses and a natural affinity for magic and archery.

name: Dwarf
description: Sturdy and resilient, dwarves are known for their resistance to poison and their mastery of stonework.

name: Halfling
description: Small and nimble, halflings are lucky and skilled at avoiding danger.

name: Orc
description: Strong and fierce, orcs favor brute strength and intimidation in combat.

name: Gnome
description: Curious and inventive, gnomes have a natural talent for illusion magic and tinkering.
